Name: Jen's Goth Flower Garden
Author: jenf1
Description:
[b][size=4]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/size][/b]

Not the type of farmer to grow colorful, vibrant flowers? These unique beauties will add some darkness and intrigue to your garden!

[b]Spring:[/b]
- Queen of Night Tulip
- Belladonna

[b]Summer:[/b]
- Black Hollyhock
- Moonflower (only blooms at night!)

[b]Fall:[/b]
- Black Baccara Rose
- Bat Flower

How do you get these lovely flowers? [u]They are NOT available for purchase at Pierre's or JojaMart![/u] Instead they are sold by a unique NPC known only as the Traveling Witch.

After playing the game for at least one week, you will receive a letter in the mail. After reading the letter, the Traveling Witch will appear by the road in the Backwoods on Mondays and Wednesdays during the Spring, Summer, and Fall. She will not appear in the Winter, as she currently has nothing to sell during that time.

This mod is safe to install mid-game. However, if you are currently in the middle of Winter, you will not receive the letter until Spring.

Compatible with SVE, Cornucopia, Wildflour's Atelier Goods, etc.

[size=5]Future Plans:[/size]

- Add more flowers
- Add more things to do with said flowers
- Maybe a sapling or two?
- Add the Traveling Witch to the Desert Festival and Night Market (and modded festival marketplaces)

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Jen's Goth Flower Garden into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

[size=5]Permissions:[/size]

For Translators: Feel free to translate! Translators should upload their translation as a separate mod to be placed inside the i18n folder of this mod, and link to this mod as a dependency. Do not include or redistribute any assets from this mod except the translated text.

For Portrait Artists: Feel free to make a portrait of the Traveling Witch to match your portrait set. However, the art cannot be AI generated in any way, shape, or form.

[size=5]Credits:[/size]
[url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]Stardew Valley Portrait Creator[/url] by JazzyBee and Poltergeister for the Traveling Witch's portrait, edited slightly by me.
